chunks: And from him, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Aʿyan, from ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, who said:

I asked Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā عليه السلام about a man and a woman who are performing tamattuʿ with the ʿumrah leading to hajj, then they enter Makkah on the Day of ʿArafah—what should they do? He said: They should make it into an individual hajj, and the limit of tamattuʿ is until the Day of al-Tarwiyah.

key_terms.الْعُمْرَةِ: The ʿumrah rite that precedes hajj in tamattuʿ.
key_terms.حَجَّةً مُفْرَدَةً: An individual hajj (ifrād), performed without the tamattuʿ arrangement.
key_terms.حَدُّ الْمُتْعَةِ: The legal time limit or boundary for the validity of tamattuʿ.
key_terms.يَتَمَتَّعَانِ: They perform hajj al-tamattuʿ, combining ʿumrah before hajj in the prescribed manner.
key_terms.يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ: The Day of ʿArafah, a critical time in the hajj rites.
key_terms.يَوْمِ التَّرْوِيَةِ: The Day of al-Tarwiyah, identified here as the endpoint for entering tamattuʿ.

ai.seo_question: What should someone performing tamattuʿ do if they enter Makkah on the Day of ʿArafah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the time limit for hajj al-tamattuʿ. It states that if pilgrims arrive in Makkah on the Day of ʿArafah, they are to change their rite to hajj al-ifrād, because the valid period for tamattuʿ extends only until the Day of al-Tarwiyah.
